description: This file initializes and seeds the catalog database with preconfigured data such as brands, types, and items for the eCommerce application. It includes methods for seeding data asynchronously, handling database migration, and retrying on failure.

classes.name: CatalogContextSeed
classes.description: A static utility class responsible for seeding the Catalog database with initial data such as brands, types, and items.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds the catalog database with predefined brands, types, and items, with retry logic for database availability.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogBrands
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined catalog brand entities to be inserted into the database.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined catalog type entities to be inserted into the database.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredItems
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined catalog item entities to be inserted into the database.
